content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], Regarding your suggestion for connecting [product_name] [article_no] to [product_name] PC Access, I am attempting to connect [product_name] [article_no] to the same software. I followed your advice and set my TSAP:21 in both remote and local configuration, but I am not seeing any data being sent or received. My computer runs Windows 7 and [product_name] PC Access SP6. If you have a simulation file, could you please share it? Thank you for your support; I appreciate your assistance.

Hi, I'm sharing my configuration as set in [product_name] software and [product_name] PC Access. Thank you for your help. Currently, I do not see any indication of data quality—good or bad—in the monitoring data.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is encountering issues with connecting a [product_name] module to [product_name] PC Access on Windows 7 using the recommended TSAP settings. Despite following prior guidance and configuring the software as suggested, there is no data transmission and no feedback about connection or data quality in the monitoring interface, which complicates troubleshooting.
